import re

def validate_tags(tags):
    # Ensure tags only contain alphanumeric characters and commas
    return bool(re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9, ]*$', tags))

# Example usage
tags = "electronics, gadgets"
print(validate_tags(tags))  # Should return True

tags_invalid = "electronics; DROP TABLE products;"
print(validate_tags(tags_invalid))  # Should return False
